name: session-host
description: A due_work_harness_host ini setting owns its host only for that pytest session; cleanup restores the previous host or unresolved factory.

actions.initFactory: host.configure with a lazy manual factory.
actions.configureA: Actual pytest Config.fromdictargs then _do_configure, with due_work_harness_host ini.
actions.cleanupA: Actual pytest Config._ensure_unconfigure invokes registered cleanup stack.
actions.configureWithoutIni: Independent pytest Config._do_configure with no host ini.
actions.inspect: Read raw production host identity and real factory counters, without resolving factories.

mutants.name: shipped-389c5bb
mutants.description: The exact pytest_plugin.pytest_configure shipped at 389c5bb, before the fix: it configures the ini host process-wide and never restores the previous one

mutants.name: eager-previous-resolution
mutants.description: Scoping the host resolves the previous lazy factory first, importing an application the session never asked for

bugs_found.summary: Repeated pytest.main() sessions in one process inherited an earlier session's due_work_harness_host instead of getting their previous host back
bugs_found.found_by: the historical audit model (audit.qnt, pinned to 389c5bb): leakedHostWitnessTest reaches the leaked host

limits: Unitized real pytest configuration/cleanup lifecycle, without full test collection in the replay.
Actual pytest.main regressions remain in test_host_initialization.py, including collection failure.
Raw private host identity is observed to avoid altering lazy factory state; factory resolution itself uses current_host API.
Two serial configurations per trace; no claim about concurrent/nested independent pytest sessions.

shipped-389c5bb runs history/pytest_configure-389c5bb.py.txt, the pre-fix hook copied verbatim from 389c5bb and pinned by SHA-256 in adapter.py; it replaces the earlier hand-written omit-host-restoration control, which reproduced the same behavior.
